from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,os,time,hashlib,uuid,socket,urllib.parse
root=Path.cwd(); s=root/'.local/step07-r7-zip-fix/final'; s.mkdir(); w=root/'artifacts'/('.step07-r7-zip-final-'+uuid.uuid4().hex); source='c8d41a680df42fe565882d93d3f85a04f7a10b22'; rows=[]
env={**os.environ,'PATH':'/Users/dingshinn/.nvm/versions/node/v22.21.1/bin:'+os.environ['PATH'],'GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL':'/dev/null','GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM':'1'}
for port in [4398,5298]:
 a=socket.socket(); assert a.connect_ex(('127.0.0.1',port))!=0,'occupied; no kill'; a.close()
conf={x.split('=',1)[0]:x.split('=',1)[1] for x in(root/'.env').read_text().splitlines()if'='in x}; assert urllib.parse.urlparse(conf['DATABASE_URL']).port==55476
env.update(DATABASE_URL=conf['DATABASE_URL'],STEP07_TEST_API_PORT='4398',WEB_PORT='5298',INTEGRATION_API_PORT='4398',TILESET_PG_BIN='/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@14/bin')
def run(label,args,cwd,expected=0):
 start=time.time(); log=s/(label+'.log')
 with log.open('w')as f:p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 b=log.read_bytes(); row={'label':label,'args':args,'cwd':str(cwd.relative_to(root)),'source':source,'exitCode':p.returncode,'expectedExit':expected,'durationSeconds':round(time.time()-start,3),'log':str(log.relative_to(root)),'logSHA256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'logBytes':len(b)}; rows.append(row); (s/'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps({'commands':rows},indent=2)+'\n'); print(json.dumps({k:row[k]for k in ['label','exitCode','durationSeconds']}),flush=True); assert p.returncode==expected,label
run('clone',['git','clone','--no-hardlinks','--single-branch','--branch','codex/step-07-studio',root.as_uri(),str(w)],root)
run('checkout',['git','checkout','--detach',source],w)
(s/'workspace.json').write_text(json.dumps({'workspace':str(w.relative_to(root)),'source':source,'PGPort':55476,'API':4398,'Web':5298,'freshDBRootPerTestInvocation':True,'envCopied':False,'owner':'step07 coder isolated final checks'},indent=2)+'\n')
run('install',['pnpm','install','--offline','--frozen-lockfile','--store-dir',str(root/'.local/step07-ci-history/pnpm-store')],w)
run('generate',['pnpm','db:generate'],w)
run('check',['pnpm','check'],w)
run('http16',['pnpm','test:step07'],w)
run('api3',['pnpm','test:integration'],w)
run('privacy5',['pnpm','test:dev-privacy'],w)
run('engineering',['pnpm','build:step07'],w)
print('LATEST_SOURCE_BASE_SUITES_AND_ENGINEERING_COMPLETE',flush=True)
